verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own Dashboard AI Assistant, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. The evidence, however, only covers MCP in other roles: Supabase acting as an MCP server for outside agents, and hosting user-built MCP servers on Edge Functions. Neither is the client capability this story asks for, and nothing shows the AI Assistant or any other part of Supabase can connect to and use external MCP servers' tools.
